correctness.rationale: The 15 free entries exhaust 32768 labelled presentations. The definition uses all bracketings, and bilinearity makes the span of bracketed words on natural-basis leaves equal to the full subspace power at each degree. A nonzero word in a triangular basis has no leaf at depth ≥6: at each step toward the root the product, if nonzero, has least nonzero coordinate strictly above the least coordinate of each child. A binary tree of height ≤5 has at most 32 leaves, yielding E^33=0. A directed cycle in the support digraph would instead allow arbitrarily long nonzero words by starting with a basis square and multiplying successively by the next basis vertex on the cycle; the new product is a nonzero scalar multiple of that next square. Thus nilpotency excludes cycles, and topological ordering gives the triangular presentation needed for the all-algebra spectrum. Independent replay `python3 /workspace/branches/independent-checks/record5.py` used the actual unspanned values of bracketed basis words at each degree, not either frozen span algorithm. For every mask it tests the first empty nonzero-value set and verifies the maximal-index criterion. The full ordered histogram is [(2,1),(3,1329),(4,574),(5,9760),(6,352),(7,1584),(8,96),(9,11648),(10,64),(11,192),(13,512),(17,5632),(33,1024)]. It also matches every first-mask witness and the ordered-byte SHA-256 31661b0672ffe4caf7417840c56b7d5b9b69a20f91d7b51ff2674843fae737f6. The supplied script was inspected, not executed. Scalar extension commutes with every power by bilinearity, preserving the witnessed indices, not excluding others. The counts are not isomorphism-class counts and the index spectrum is for nilpotent algebras.

value.rationale: Dimension six is a motivated spectrum cutoff in the cited survey, and the binary field is a natural setting where products of spans can cancel. An exact exclusion theorem for all binary nilpotent evolution algebras in that dimension, with labelled multiplicities quantifying rare strata such as index 10 (64 cases), is a reusable benchmark for a structural classification. Its value does not depend on extrapolating to infinite fields, and is not the already implied maximal bin.
